pages.title: Electrical subcontract · Project overview
paragraphs: Riverside Office Renovation. Customer: Northline Builders. Contractor: Summit Electrical.
Agreed contract value: $125,000. Project dates: Oct 5 – Nov 20, 2026.
Electrical fit-out under drawing E-101 Rev A, with scope and pricing exhibits incorporated.

pages.title: Exhibit A · Included scope
paragraphs: Supply and install 48 outlets at the locations shown on E-101 Rev A.
Supply and install 24 LED fixtures.
Six branch circuits included in the signed scope.
Complete testing and labeling of installed circuits.

pages.title: Exhibit A · Exclusions and changes
paragraphs: Weekend installation excluded.
Modifications to existing service equipment excluded.
Additional work and proposed pricing are subject to the contractual change and approval procedure.

pages.title: Exhibit B · Pricing basis
paragraphs: Additional labor: $100 per hour, subject to the contract change procedure.
Materials: documented cost.
No weekend premium is specified in this sample exhibit.

pages.title: Change order CO-001
paragraphs: Provide two additional dedicated branch circuits for conference-room equipment.
Approved additional amount: $8,500.
Signed acceptance recorded by the customer project manager on Oct 8, 2026.

pages.title: Work completion record
paragraphs: Location: conference room. Reference: CO-001.
Two additional conference-room circuits installed under CO-001.
Testing completed and work recorded by the foreman on Oct 9, 2026.

pages.title: Invoice INV-014
paragraphs: Bill to: Northline Builders. Project: Riverside Office Renovation.
Original scope billing: $125,000.
No separate CO-001 charge is listed in this fictional invoice.

pages.title: Invoice INV-015
paragraphs: Bill to: Northline Builders. Project: Riverside Office Renovation.
CO-002 lighting upgrade: $1,500.
This previously invoiced upgrade is distinct from the two additional fixtures proposed in SI-009. No CO-001 charge is listed.

pages.title: Site instruction SI-009
paragraphs: Project: Riverside Office Renovation.
Revised installation requires 26 LED fixtures.
Submit pricing for the additional quantity for customer review.

pages.title: Quotation · Additional fixtures
paragraphs: Two additional LED fixtures, supplied and installed.
Quantity 2 × $800 each = $1,600 proposed.
Customer acceptance has not been recorded in the supplied file.

pages.title: Site instruction SI-008
paragraphs: Project: Riverside Office Renovation.
Complete the installation during Saturday access.
This instruction documents the requested access window; separate price acceptance is not included.

pages.title: Crew timesheet · Saturday work
paragraphs: Work: installation during Saturday access, reference SI-008.
Nine labor hours recorded.
At the $100/hour rate in Exhibit B: $900 labor cost. No weekend premium assumed.

circuits.title: Additional conference-room circuits
circuits.reason: The completion record and signed change describe the same circuits. No matching charge was identified in the supplied invoices. Confirm billing coverage before issuing a new charge.
evidence: Six branch circuits included in the signed scope.
Two additional conference-room circuits approved at $8,500 and recorded as completed.
Neither supplied invoice contains a matching CO-001 charge.

fixtures.title: Two additional LED fixtures
fixtures.reason: The revised quantity exceeds the original scope by two fixtures. The quoted all-in rate is $800 each, producing a $1,600 proposal. No prior billing or customer acceptance was found in the supplied records.
evidence: Two additional fixtures, supplied and installed: 2 × $800 = $1,600.

weekend.title: Weekend installation
weekend.approval: Proposed change · Authorization unresolved; customer sign-off required
weekend.reason: A field instruction requests work excluded from the original agreement. The timesheet records nine hours at the $100/hour rate, supporting $900 in labor cost. That cost alone does not establish payment entitlement.
evidence: Complete the installation during Saturday access.
Nine hours recorded at $100/hour = $900. No weekend premium assumed.
